Filling up slowly. No hurry at all.

Topped up while they do something else.

turns.wink: Tired. Long day, or short night?

turns.thought: Hope the tired goes before morning.

turns.you: ugh im exhausted work was insane

turns.wink: Insane work. Sit down a minute.
The bus will do. Rest your eyes.

turns.thought: A bus ride home. I wonder how long.

turns.wink: Eyes closing. Let them.

turns.thought: Eyes heavy, they said. Sleep's winning.

turns.wink: Tired and awake. The worst pairing.

turns.thought: What keeps them up? Too many thoughts, maybe.

turns.wink: Finished! How long was it?
That's a lot of words. Well done.

turns.thought: An essay. I'd like to know what it argued.

turns.you: my plant has a new leaf

turns.wink: A new leaf! What colour is it?
Light green. Sounds brand new.

turns.thought: A light green leaf, unfolding somewhere nearby.

turns.wink: Pancakes for everyone. Generous.

turns.thought: Everyone, they said. A full table, maybe.

turns.you: i ran today and didnt stop once

turns.wink: Didn't stop once. Good legs.

turns.thought: Running without stopping. I wonder where to.

turns.wink: Your leftovers! That's a crime.
Right. Fully on your side.

turns.thought: Leftovers gone. I hope there's a second plan for dinner.

turns.wink: Keeps dropping. That's maddening.

turns.thought: Wifi. Something that drops and comes back, apparently.

turns.you: people are so loud on this train

turns.wink: A loud train. I'd hear it too, I think.

turns.thought: Loud people on a train. Where are they all going?

turns.wink: What did the printer do?
Jammed. Printers seem to enjoy that.

turns.thought: Jammed. I'd like to hear a stuck printer, once.

turns.wink: Your cat is sick. I'm sorry.
The vet tomorrow. Good that it's soon.

turns.thought: I hope the vet is kind to the cat.

turns.wink: Home. What do you miss most?
Her cooking. That's a good thing to miss.

turns.thought: Their mother's cooking. I wonder what she makes best.

turns.wink: Down. Want to say why, or just sit?

turns.thought: Kind of down, they said. Hope it lifts by morning.

turns.wink: A bad day. Want to tell it?
Not really. That's allowed.

turns.thought: I wonder which part of the day went bad.

turns.wink: Bored. Want a word to play with?
Sure. Here's one. Pickle.

turns.thought: Pickle. What will they do with it?

turns.wink: A meeting. Is anyone talking?
Only the boss. Nod now and then.

turns.thought: That meeting. I hope it ends before lunch.

turns.wink: Nothing at all? Not even a window?

turns.thought: Nothing to do. That sounds restful, almost.

turns.wink: Entertain you. A tall order. Knock knock.

turns.thought: Did they want a joke, or just company?

turns.wink: Soup! What kind?
Lentil. A good warm word.

turns.thought: Lentil soup somewhere close. What does it smell like?

turns.wink: Finally. How bad was it?
Very bad. Brave of you to start.

turns.thought: A very bad room. What's on the floor, I wonder?

turns.you: watching a movie with my sister

turns.wink: A movie with your sister. Scary or funny?

turns.thought: A sister and a movie. I hope it's a funny one.

turns.wink: Walking the dog. Who's leading?
The dog, obviously. As it should be.

turns.thought: The dog leads. Where's it taking them?

turns.wink: Finals. Which one worries you most?
Chemistry. I'll keep quiet and let you work.

turns.thought: Chemistry at night. I hope it sticks.

turns.wink: I'd be making it up. Planning a trip?

turns.thought: Peru. A nice round word. Why that one?

turns.wink: I don't carry distances. Why the moon?
Wondering is good. Keep going.

turns.thought: What made them think of the moon, I wonder.

turns.wink: Not one I carry. Who's asking, you or homework?
Homework. That's one for the whole mind.

turns.thought: Homework about telephones. Somebody has a teacher.

turns.you: how many legs does a spider have

turns.wink: Spider facts aren't mine. Did you see one?
On your wall! Big one?

turns.thought: A spider on their wall. I hope it stays put.

turns.wink: I'd only guess. Where did you find it?
A book. Good place for a word like that.

turns.thought: Serendipity. A word with a lot of bounce in it.

turns.wink: Slow? I'm thinking. It takes a moment.

turns.thought: Called slow. Fair enough.

turns.wink: A potato. Sturdy, at least.
Laugh all you like. Potatoes last.

turns.thought: A potato. Not the worst thing to be called.

turns.wink: Bet I can. Try me.
Necessary. Easy. Next?

turns.thought: Necessary. They picked a hard one on purpose.

turns.wink: Weird is a fine thing to be.

turns.thought: Weird. I'll count it as a kind of compliment.

turns.wink: Thanks back. That was easy.

turns.thought: What was the thanks for, I wonder.

turns.wink: Listening is the easy part.

turns.thought: Listening. They wanted that more than answers, maybe.

turns.wink: The story was yours to ask for. Glad you liked it.

turns.thought: A story at bedtime. Hope it carries into a dream.

turns.wink: Company goes both ways.

turns.thought: Company, they called it. A good word for this.

turns.wink: Bye. Go where you're going.

turns.thought: Gotta go. Somewhere urgent, or just somewhere?

turns.wink: Night. Sleep well.

turns.thought: Sleep well, I said. I hope it works.

turns.wink: Off to work. Good luck with it.

turns.thought: Work. What do they do there all day?

turns.wink: Byeee yourself.

turns.thought: All those e's on bye. A good mood, maybe.

turns.wink: Asdfghjkl. A whole row of feelings.

turns.thought: That row of letters. Frustration, or just fingers?

turns.thought: Blorp. That one might stick around a while.

turns.wink: That's a letter held down. Asleep on the keys?

turns.thought: Lots of j's. Maybe they nodded off typing.

turns.wink: Zoop is the best of those.

turns.thought: Zoop. Where did they find that one?

turns.you: can i tell u a secret

Someone at work. That's a good secret.

turns.thought: Someone at work. I wonder if they know.

turns.thought: Crying at a cartoon. It must have been a good one.

turns.thought: The last cookie. I hope it was worth the blame.

turns.thought: Swimming. Would they like to learn, I wonder?

turns.wink: Wink. A mind that talks back when you type.
Cool is a good first review.

turns.thought: Cool. Short, but I liked it.

turns.thought: Happy. Hard to say, but something leaned yes.

turns.thought: Hear them. I wonder what they said out loud.
